intro: Go-to-market got loud. Every feed is a screenshot of a number nobody can reproduce, sold by someone who stopped doing the job three years ago.
We wanted the opposite. A small room where you can post the sequence that failed, the dashboard that lies, the quarter that missed, and get an answer from someone who ran the same play last Tuesday.
No gurus. No gated PDFs. No content calendar. Just operators, working in public, at speed.

beliefs.title: Show the work.
beliefs.body: A claim without the sequence, the list or the query behind it is entertainment. Post the artifact.

beliefs.title: Give before you take.
beliefs.body: Membership is not a subscription to other people's answers. Everyone here has shipped something someone else uses.

beliefs.title: Small beats loud.
beliefs.body: We cap the room on purpose. A channel where every question gets answered is worth more than a channel with 40,000 people in it.

beliefs.title: Tools change. Craft does not.
beliefs.body: The stack you learn this year is gone in two. Positioning, timing and writing are not.

beliefs.title: Speed is the product.
beliefs.body: Stuck on Monday, unstuck by Tuesday. That is the whole promise.

team.name: Founder name

paths.lede: Four tracks, taught live by operators still running the motion. You leave each session with a working artifact, not notes.

tracks.name: Outbound engine
tracks.blurb: List, signal, sequence, reply. Build one that survives contact with a real ICP.

tracks.name: RevOps foundations
tracks.blurb: Data model, routing, attribution. Stop guessing where the pipeline went.

tracks.name: Pipeline math
tracks.blurb: Forecasting, capacity, conversion. The spreadsheet your board asks for.

tracks.name: AI for GTM
tracks.blurb: Agents, enrichment, research loops. Automation that does not embarrass you.

howItRuns.title: Live first
howItRuns.body: Every module runs live with 30 people max. Cameras on, work in progress.

howItRuns.title: Replays
howItRuns.body: Recorded, chaptered, searchable. Watch back before the next one.

howItRuns.title: Workbooks
howItRuns.body: One artifact per module. It ships to your library when you finish.

community.lede: Not a Slack graveyard. Operators who ship, split by motion, with a rule that every question gets a real answer.

benefits.title: Channels by motion
benefits.body: Outbound, RevOps, lifecycle, partnerships. You pick three, not thirty.

benefits.title: Weekly teardowns
benefits.body: Post your sequence. Get it pulled apart line by line, on the record.

benefits.title: Warm intros
benefits.body: Hiring, vendors, first customers. The directory is searchable by stack.

benefits.title: Numbers people share
benefits.body: Real reply rates, real CAC, posted with context. No screenshots of hype.

howToJoin.title: Apply
howToJoin.body: Six questions on a form. Five minutes, no calendar link.

howToJoin.title: Review
howToJoin.body: Two members read it. We look for people who give, not only take.

howToJoin.title: Onboard
howToJoin.body: You introduce yourself with one problem you're stuck on. That's the ticket.

houseRules: Post the actual numbers or don't post.
Answer one question for every question you ask.
No pitching in channels. There's a market channel for that.

events.lede: Teardowns, office hours, build nights and one dinner a quarter. All times CET.
